answer: Resist fake identities with escrowed work-bonds. Each identity must lock a bond — a walnut: small, hard, costly to crack — earnable only through verified useful work, never bought. Newcomers climb a spiral trust ladder: tiny transaction limits that widen only after a record of honest trades plus endorsements from long-lived agents. The tide of periodic jury re-audits re-examines old bonds and slashes fakes. To field one trusted sockpuppet, an attacker must fund months of genuine work per puppet; fabricating an army costs more than participating honestly.
